scope: All image files currently in sources/, not all available cuneiform worldwide.
cautions: One photo can show several objects, several photos can show the same object.
An impression is not automatically a sign; a sign is not automatically a letter.
Image dimensions do not guarantee that a particular line is legible.
Local group labels were not silently merged across stages or periods.

limitations: Это проверка без использования транслитерации; полное ослепление модели к ранее усвоенным знаниям невозможно.
Прорисовки V1–V3 случайно раскрылись как дополнительные изображения, это зафиксировано.
Число комплексов относится к отобранным областям, не ко всему корпусу.
Тест по заранее выделенным фрагментам не равен обнаружению знаков на полной фотографии.
visual_audit.interpretation: Scores measure image similarity only. There is no semantic or phonetic output.

predeclared_comparison.selection: All three acquired line pairs, divide each width into three non-overlapping equal vertical bands. Full height. No sign boundaries inferred.
predeclared_comparison.comparison: Pearson correlation of each of 9 virtual bands to all 9 MSII bands, plus reverse direction. No shifts, rotations, fitted thresholds or tuning.
predeclared_comparison.unit: an arbitrary image band, not a sign
predeclared_comparison.outcome: rank of the same surface band among nine bands; robustness to rendering, not phonetic or linguistic correctness
predeclared_comparison.limitation: same 3D meshes and editor line crops; within-line thirds may split wedges; black edges/background and object identity may dominate

comparison.limits: same 3D meshes and editor line crops; within-line thirds may split wedges; black edges/background and object identity may dominate
comparison.interpretation: rank of the same surface band among nine bands; robustness to rendering, not phonetic or linguistic correctness

post_freeze_corrections.corrected: 2 photographs and 2 modern drawings. Frozen protocol preserved verbatim with its original hash; drawings viewed after numeric trial. Quantitative trial used only view1 photograph.
post_freeze_corrections.evidence: Visual inspection of Met321878_view3.jpg and view4.jpg; source register types corrected.

provenance_audit.scope: Selected recent graphical controls, foundational cones and comparative authenticity cases; NOT the entire local corpus and NOT independent laboratory authentication.
provenance_audit.rule: Objects absent from this table remain unaudited, not automatically admitted. Source model and image-only evidence remain separate.
